summary: Fortuna Mining Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release announcing that it has filed a National Instrument 43-101 technical report for the Diamba Sud Gold Project in Senegal. The report supports the feasibility study results previously announced on June 29, 2026. This is a routine disclosure obligation for a foreign private issuer reporting mineral project technical information. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change is involved. The filing is purely a technical reporting update under Canadian securities law, mapped to a US equivalent of a periodic report on Form 6-K.
